messages:
Jamie (CEO): Quick pulse-check after the all-hands — where are we on the RCA for the model-loading spike? Need a short summary for execs.
Priya (infra): RCA uploaded: https://redwood.internal/rcas/INC-2026-075 — root cause was an automated rollout that didn't account for a new variant churn pattern, causing many ephemeral loads and KV eviction.
Omar (SRE): Short customer-friendly summary suggestion: "We had a transient spike in model loads from an internal rollout which increased latency for some customers; mitigation restored normal performance and were adding safeguards."
Leah (product): Leadership asks: 1) named owners + dates in this thread; 2) what one policy will we publish to reduce this class of incidents?
Dev (eng): Policy suggestion (one-liner): "All rollout scripts must validate variant stability and run an alias-consistency canary before changing registry tags."
Priya (infra): Owners & dates: 1) Canary & alias-check CI  owner: Dev (eng)  ETA: 2026-04-03. 2) KV eviction threshold tuning + alerting  owner: Omar (SRE)  ETA: 2026-03-31. 3) Customer outreach note + impacted list  owner: Leah (product)  ETA: 2026-03-29.
Omar (SRE): Filed an alert rule change ticket for KV eviction tail: https://ops.redwood/tickets/TKT-912 — will add dashboard tile for pool-level eviction rate.
Dev (eng): I'll open PR for alias-canary CI integration and add a tiny smoke job. Snippet for the smoke job: 
```
# smoke-canary.sh
REG=$1; ALIAS=$2
curl -fs $REG/aliases | jq -e ".[] | select(.name==\"$ALIAS\")" || exit 1
```
Leah (product): opsbot, pull impacted accounts for the affected pools so we can prioritize AE outreach.
opsbot: Impact list: 12 accounts flagged. Link: https://ops.redwood/impacts/INC-2026-075
Jamie (CEO): Please ensure AEs are looped for the top 5 revenue accounts ASAP. Also, add an ETA to the all-hands follow-up tracker.
Priya (infra): I'll update the all-hands follow-up doc with owners and ETAs and link it here: https://redwood.internal/allhands/followups/2026-03-27
Omar (SRE): Small ask: if anyone updates an ETA here, also update the follow-up tracker so we don't get conflicting dates.
Dev (eng): PR opened: https://git.redwood/eng/PR-4442  contains alias-canary and unit tests. Tagging @Omar for staging smoke run.
Leah (product): Draft customer message posted to #customer-comms for review — will link after approvals.
Jamie (CEO): Thanks. We'll review progress in next all-hands follow-up slot — ping me directly if owners hit blockers. :eyes:
Priya (infra): Marking this thread as canonical for owner updates on INC-2026-075. :white_check_mark:
